title: 20-analytics-resume-page.json is doubly-encoded: JSON root is a string, not an object
evidence:
"{
 "freshFormSectionEvents": "see note",
 "resumePageEvents": [
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture", ... (file is a single line, 484 bytes; verified with python3: json.load(...) returns <class 'str'>, requiring a second json.loads to reach the object)
detail: A .json evidence artifact whose top-level value is a quoted, escaped JSON string breaks the contract tooling expects: any JSON parser yields a string, not the recorded event data. Every other artifact in the folder is directly consumable.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the file as the decoded JSON object (strip the outer quoting/escaping) so standard parsers return the resumePageEvents/tokenInAnyPayload structure directly.

title: Analytics notes claim 10 autocapture events on resume page; companion JSON records 15 (+1 draft_saved, 16 total)
evidence: 21-analytics-notes.md line 24: "- Recorded on the resume page: 10 × $autocapture + application_draft_saved." — but 20-analytics-resume-page.json resumePageEvents lists 16 entries: 10 × "$autocapture", then "application_draft_saved", then 5 more "$autocapture" (verified by decoding: total 16, autocapture 15, draft_saved 1).
detail: Two committed evidence artifacts for the same observation disagree on the event count. Substantive claims (no section_entered/completed on resume, tokenInAnyPayload: false) are unaffected, but the mismatch undermines cross-referencing.
recommended_fix: Update the notes line to match the JSON of record (e.g. "15 × $autocapture + application_draft_saved") or annotate that the count was taken before the final five autocapture events.

title: Skills-migration PR leaves stale .claude/skills/* ignore entries; bmad re-add guard no longer covers .pi/skills/
evidence:
# Arize skill symlinks (per-machine setup) + lockfile
.claude/skills/arize-*

# bmad skills are pi-global (canonical ~/.pi/agent/skills) - never re-add per-repo copies
.claude/skills/bmad-*
detail: The PR deletes .claude/skills/ (confirmed absent in worktree) and updates the adjacent fixtures entry to .pi/skills/, but leaves these two entries pointing at the retired path. The bmad guard's stated intent (block per-repo re-adds) now misses .pi/skills/bmad-*, where such copies would land today and be picked up by git add.
recommended_fix: Migrate the guards alongside the fixtures line: replace .claude/skills/bmad-* with .pi/skills/bmad-* (and .claude/skills/arize-* with the arize skills' current per-machine location, or drop the entry if .agents/skills/ tracking made it obsolete).
